status: Concrete concept for visual implementation; not flight-qualified
primary_objective: Minimise fleet antimatter while preserving family habitation, landing and exploration

coordinates.axis: z is the longitudinal axis; negative z is the direction of travel
coordinates.camera: Use separate crew-bus and full-fleet scale views; never stretch the bus to fill the 2 km tow span

crew_geometry.surface_role: reuse backing with fresh TPS; include in descent load

crew_geometry.purpose: compression member balances inward tow-cable forces

habitat.transfer: Sealed transfer capsules synchronise, hard-dock, isolate, undock and despin before docking to the static module; no unqualified continuous rotating pressure seal
habitat.construction: Hybrid composite restraint shells/cores with replaceable liners and insulation; expandable packing retained only where beneficial

propulsion.braking: Reposition both tugs to z=+2000 m and aft tow anchors with engines off; retain bus attitude and forward dust shield; rotate tugs to reverse thrust

radiation.torpor_shielding_priority: Concentrate strongest useful-mass protection around torpor/sleep berths; uniform shielding of all rooms is not required
radiation.dose_assessment: docs/COSMIC_RAY_EXPOSURE.md; actual interstellar dose unresolved and benchmark cases exceed target
radiation.fuel_cell_rule: Drain remote tanks first, refill paired cells symmetrically; never spend protected 36 t refuge inventory as main propulsion reserve
radiation.child_and_pregnancy_limits: Separate organ/age-dependent requirements remain unresolved; adult target is not a child limit
radiation.gcr_status: Unclosed research requirement; allowance is not an engineered magnetic shield or proof of protection
radiation.active_shield_visual: Dashed reserved equipment volume only; no invented coil field or dose-reduction animation

landing.baseline: Mars-like-atmosphere-assisted entry; not a confirmed planet property
landing.terminal_propulsion: Hydrolox chemical engines; no direct annihilation source under the occupied lander
landing.optional_thermal_upgrade_status: Separate unqualified technology trade; no saving credited in baseline
landing.vacuum_branch_status: Separate predeparture loading/hardware variant; chemical baseline may be mass-prohibitive; no airless landing promise
landing.landed_modules: Three joined modules on a load-carrying entry cradle; stop rotation, lock, restrain all 64; separate/deploy surface frames after touchdown
landing.main_stage_disposal: Controlled orbit before entry; no unpowered low-altitude jettison

power.source: Two independent fission-electric service units, one nominal and one reserve; carry both to surface
power.transit_location: Remote power cassettes on the tow assembly; shielded casks transfer to lander for descent
power.surface_location: Remotely deployed cassettes with shield geometry and exclusion area to be qualified
power.status: Design-to mass and lifetime; not a demonstrated 40-year reactor

cargo.layout: Axial packed cargo and water tanks; uncrewed, no gravity habitat; two remote propulsion pods
cargo.source: Reuses prior cargo payload ledger; new tug and arrival hardware charged in the calculator

validation_gates: Engine shadow-shield transport, scattered radiation and cooling
2 km tow dynamics, plume clearance and braking reconfiguration
Continuous-tank and water-cell protection mapping through reserve use
Habitat structural, pressure-cycle, floor and rotation qualification
50 m aeroshell entry corridor and one-engine-out landing trajectory
Mars-like atmosphere confirmed or vacuum variant selected before crew commitment
Closed food/material loops and qualified reactor/antimatter storage lifetime
